subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should this issue be scoped to warning-only Control UI budget visibility first, or should OpenClaw also block oversized MEMORY.md saves and design auto-archive behavior now?
rationale: Current main already has partial diagnostics, but save refusal and archive behavior change user memory editing and recovery semantics beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Ship warning-only first
options.body: Add a Control UI MEMORY.md budget indicator and near-limit warning while leaving save blocking and archive behavior for separate product decisions.

options.title: Block oversized saves
options.body: Make the Control UI or `agents.files.set` refuse saves over the configured bootstrap budget with a visible override and recovery path.

options.title: Design archive workflow separately
options.body: Treat auto-archive as a memory persistence feature with pointers, undo, and doctor or recovery integration before implementation.

recommendation.title: Ship warning-only first
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI MEMORY.md budget indicator and near-limit warning while leaving save blocking and archive behavior for separate product decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras has the strongest combined history across bootstrap warning handling and the Agents dashboard file surface.
